entities.name: Josef Smolka
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Josef Smolka was a Czech volleyball player who competed for Czechoslovakia in the 1968 Summer Olympics. In 1968 he was part of the Czechoslovak team which won the bronze medal in the Olympic tournament. He played seven matches.
